items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When he'd call him King -- I mean why did he call him King? [INTERVIEWEE] He played so much alto.

ctx.x: When he'd call him King -- I mean why did he call him King?
He played so much alto. He wasn't playing the trumpet then, but he liked the trumpet later. Oh, after his cousin came there, then naturally he played the trumpet.
